seoTitle: New Hanover County Schools Calendar 2026-2027: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: See the 2026–27 NHCS traditional calendar with the Aug. 24 first day, March 29–April 2 Spring Break, June 4 last day, official PDFs, and calendar downloads.
heroSummary: The NHCS traditional calendar lists Monday, August 24, 2026 as the first day of school, with staggered enrollment August 24–26. The last day for students is Friday, June 4, 2027, and it is a half day. Official Spring Break runs March 29–April 2. With a teacher workday on March 25 and the Good Friday holiday on March 26, students are off from March 25 through April 2 and return Monday, April 5.

customSections.label: Major Student No-School Periods
customSections.content: These ranges highlight the main extended periods when students on the traditional calendar are not scheduled to attend. Standalone holidays and teacher workdays appear in the complete calendar below.

rows: November 25 is an undesignated teacher workday; November 26–27 are Thanksgiving holidays.
December 21 is an undesignated teacher workday; December 22–23 and 29–31 are vacation days; December 24–28 are Christmas holidays; January 1 is the New Year’s Day holiday.
March 25 is a designated teacher workday; March 26 is the Good Friday holiday; March 29–April 2 is the official Spring Break.
table.footnote: Students return Monday, January 4 after the winter period and Monday, April 5 after the spring period.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
content: The first day moves from August 26 in 2025–26 to August 24 in 2026–27.
The last day moves from June 5 in 2025–26 to June 4 in 2026–27; both calendars mark the last day as a half day for students.
The official Spring Break week moves from April 6–10, 2026 to March 29–April 2, 2027.
In 2026–27, a designated teacher workday and the Good Friday holiday extend the spring student no-school period to March 25–April 2.

comparisonTitle: NHCS 2026–27 Calendar Compared With Brunswick County Schools
comparisonSummary: NHCS and Brunswick County both start August 24 and share the March 29–April 2 Spring Break week, but Brunswick County ends May 28, one week before NHCS ends June 4.
comparisonFooterText: Thanksgiving and winter rows show weekdays when students are not scheduled to attend. The spring row preserves each district’s official Spring Break week and excludes adjacent holidays or workdays.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are NHCS students off before Spring Break begins?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are also off Thursday, March 25 for a designated teacher workday and Friday, March 26 for the Good Friday holiday. Together with the official break week, that creates a continuous student no-school period from March 25 through April 2.

calendarFaqs.q: Can NHCS change the calendar after it is approved?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Weather, board action, or instructional-time needs may change the calendar. Use the official NHCS live calendar and school announcements before booking travel or arranging child care.
